_comment: Challenge-2A SAMPLE arena (NAV-2). A realistic-shaped map for the test suite + a SITL dry-run, NOT the real briefing geometry. EVERY number here is briefing/onsite-tunable: re-measure the arena rectangle, crate footprints, pad centres, taped lanes, and the C2 launch pose at gate F and overwrite this file (tune config, not code). Frame: (north_m, east_m), +north/+east; headings deg CCW-positive (0 = +north), the pyhulax/dead_reckon yaw sign.
_comment_bounds: bounds_m = [north_min, east_min, north_max, east_max], the keep-in geofence rectangle. ~12 m (north) x 10 m (east) placeholder; widen/shrink to the taped arena edges onsite. Validator: north_min < north_max and east_min < east_max (strict).
_comment_c2: C2 launch pose: c2_origin_m = where the swarm boots (must be INSIDE bounds_m); c2_heading_deg = the common compass heading every drone boots aligned to (deg, CCW+). 90 deg here = the fleet boots facing WEST (-east); onsite this is whichever way the team lines the airframes up at gate D. Re-measure both.
_comment_keep_out: Crate / obstacle footprints (no-fly polygons), rings of [north_m, east_m] vertices. NAV-1 inflates each by the safety margin before planning. Validator: >= 3 DISTINCT vertices, unique ids. 4 placeholder crates; re-trace the real footprints + add/remove crates onsite.

keep_out._comment: Crate B — rectangular obstacle on the east lane.
Crate C — triangular barrier near the north wall.
Crate D — small square between the two pad clusters.

_comment_pads: Candidate landing pads (hoop targets). center_m = [north_m, east_m] (must be INSIDE bounds_m); radius_m = hoop radius (m, > 0); valid mirrors the GREEN(true)/RED(false) ArUco beside the pad — NOT geometry. 5 pads: 3 valid (green) + 2 invalid (red). Validator: center within bounds, unique ids, radius > 0. Re-measure centres + flip valid flags to the briefing onsite.

pads._comment: Valid pad on the edge (flush to the north wall — closed bounds, legal).
Invalid (red) decoy pads — flying here must score zero / be refused by land_on_pad.

_comment_lanes: Taped floor lanes (ADVISORY reference polylines only — never a hard control input), each a list of [north_m, east_m] points. 2 placeholder lanes tracing the convoy path; re-trace from the taped floor onsite.
